# Truthworld

> Truthworld is a high-integrity, family-safe video streaming and creator monetization platform featuring automated AI-powered fact checking, localization and dubbing across 70+ languages, 100+ subtitle options, and 100% ad revenue share for creators.

Truthworld empowers content creators and viewers through algorithmic transparency, verified claims, multi-language speech dubbing, creator studio analytics, and high-impact transparent advertising.

## Core Features
- [AI Fact Checking](https://www.truthworld.in): Real-time multi-layered claim verification and credibility labels.
- [Truthworld Dubbing Studio](https://www.truthworld.in/dubbing): Standalone AI voice dubbing, speaker-matched voice cloning, multilingual subtitles, and waveform segment editor ([dubbing.truthworld.in](https://dubbing.truthworld.in)).
- [Creator Studio](https://www.truthworld.in/studio): Complete channel management, upload pipeline, and real-time revenue analytics.
- [Advertisements Platform](https://www.truthworld.in/advertisements): Transparent video advertising campaigns with detailed performance tracking.
- [Discover & Trending](https://www.truthworld.in/trending): Community-driven topic discussions, curated playlists, and trending verified video stories.

## Navigation & Resources
- [Home](https://www.truthworld.in/): Main video feed and curated recommendations.
- [Explore Topics](https://www.truthworld.in/browse): Browse categorized topics, channels, and verified content.
- [Truthworld Dubbing Studio](https://www.truthworld.in/dubbing): AI voice dubbing, subtitle localization, and segment timeline editing.
- [Creator Studio](https://www.truthworld.in/studio): Creator dashboard, video management, and channel customization.
- [Advertiser Portal](https://www.truthworld.in/advertisements): Campaign management and advertising console.
- [Trending](https://www.truthworld.in/trending): Most popular and trending videos across Truthworld.
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.truthworld.in/guidelines): Safety policies, content verification standards, and community guidelines.
